title: Do Coupons Create Sales, or Just Give Money Away?

s1.description: The question and the first impression: coupon recipients spend several times more, and the gap shrinks once we compare like with like

s2.description: Two traps: the retailer selects on shopping frequency, and selected households are at a high point

s3.description: The causal graph, the backdoor adjustment and the main result: with comparable controls there is no detectable lift, and fifteen estimators agree

s4.description: Mechanism: most coupons go unused, the used ones buy what households already buy, and no type of household responds

s5.description: The limits of the data, the experiment that would settle it, the conclusion and recommendations

s6.description: Appendix: robustness, method details, overlap, Bayesian network, instrumental variable, g-formula and the course map
